nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sideB_eq (p q : Q (F.par n) (Fq (F.par n) (F.hk n)) X)
    (u v : Ans (F.par n) (Fq (F.par n) (F.hk n)))
    (hu : ansFmt p.1.2 u = true) (hv : ansFmt q.1.2 v = true) (chk : Bool)
    (hchk : chkPlan p.1 = true → chk = check p.2.1 ((regs6 (F.par n)).ptOf p.2.2) (vals6 u)) :
    sideB (unary (F.par n).k) (unary (F.par n).m') (List.ofFn (F.desc n)) chk p.1 q.1
        (blocksV (F.hk n) (F.par n) p.2.2) (blocksV (F.hk n) (F.par n) q.2.2)
        (ansB (F.hk n) u) (ansB (F.hk n) v) =
      side (F.sel n) (F.sel' n) check p q u v := by sorry

variable (F : PcpFamily) (n : ℕ) {X : Type*}
  (check : X → (Fin (F.par n).m' → Fq (F.par n) (F.hk n)) →
    (Fin ((F.par n).m' + 6) → Fq (F.par n) (F.hk n)) → Bool)

nodes.docstring:
**The typed predicate is the predicate on bits**: for questions whose PCP halves have the
blocks `blocksV`, and game-check verdicts `chkP`, `chkQ` that are the game check wherever a type
asks for it.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.verdictB_eq (p q : Q (F.par n) (Fq (F.par n) (F.hk n)) X) (a b : BitStr)
    (chkP chkQ : Bool)
    (hP : ∀ u, parse (fld (F.par n) (F.hk n)) p.1.2 a = some u → chkPlan p.1 = true →
      chkP = check p.2.1 ((regs6 (F.par n)).ptOf p.2.2) (vals6 u))
    (hQ : ∀ v, parse (fld (F.par n) (F.hk n)) q.1.2 b = some v → chkPlan q.1 = true →
      chkQ = check q.2.1 ((regs6 (F.par n)).ptOf q.2.2) (vals6 v)) :
    verdictB (unary (F.par n).k) (unary (F.par n).m') (List.ofFn (F.desc n)) chkP chkQ p.1 q.1
        (blocksV (F.hk n) (F.par n) p.2.2) (blocksV (F.hk n) (F.par n) q.2.2) a b =
      match parse (fld (F.par n) (F.hk n)) p.1.2 a, parse (fld (F.par n) (F.hk n)) q.1.2 b with
      | some u, some v => accepts (F.sel n) (F.sel' n) check p q u v
      | _, _ => false := by sorry

  (check : X → (Fin (F.par n).m' → Fq (F.par n) (F.hk n)) →
    (Fin ((F.par n).m' + 6) → Fq (F.par n) (F.hk n)) → Bool)

nodes.docstring:
The cost of one marginal call through the universal machine, before the machine's overhead:
the input sampler's program, the query, and the input sampler's time on it.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.margCall_pdom (ℓ : ℕ) : ∃ c m e, ∀ {W X K : ℕ} (sp : Prog) (n Q : ℕ) (q : Data)
    (t : ℕ), 1 ≤ X → esize sp ≤ W → n ≤ W → Q ≤ W → q.size + 1 ≤ (4 * ℓ + 44) * (W + 1) →
    t ≤ Q * (q.size + 1) ^ K →
    PDom W X K c m e (esize sp + (Data.cons (encode n) q).size + t) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**The running time of the typed answer-reduced decider**, on every input `(n, d)` whose size is
dominated and whose two question fields have oracle halves no longer than `W` — as the detyped
decider's inputs have: their oracle halves are the input sampler's questions.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.typedDecider_time (ℓ : ℕ) (PD : PcpDecider) (R : Polynomial ℕ) (cd md ed : ℕ) :
    ∃ C M E, ∀ {W X : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (lam mu sigma n : ℕ), ParamsBound PD R →
    1 ≤ X → arQ lam mu n ≤ W → lam ≤ W → sigma ≤ W → n ≤ W → esize V.sampler.prog ≤ W →
    esize V.decider.prog ≤ W → V.sampler.TimeBoundAt n (arQ lam mu n) mu →
    ∀ d : Data, PDom W X mu cd md ed d.size →
    (readBits (treeHead (treeTail d))).length ≤ W + (dB PD lam mu sigma n).length →
    (readBits (treeHead (treeTail (treeTail (treeTail d))))).length ≤
      W + (dB PD lam mu sigma n).length →
    ∃ r t, PDom W X mu C M E t ∧
      (typedDecider PD V lam mu sigma).prog.Runs (.cons (encode n) d) r t := by sorry

theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.side_honest (tp tq : Role × PcpTy) (xp xq : X) (w : Coord P → F) (Hp Hq : HPolys P F)
    (hp : Hp.LowDeg) (hpo : tp.1 = .oracle → Hp.Oracle (check xp))
    (hc : Consistent tp.1 tq.1 Hp Hq) :
    side S S' check (tp, xp, (pres P S S' tp.2).eval w) (tq, xq, (pres P S S' tq.2).eval w)
      (honestAns S S' Hp tp.2 ((pres P S S' tp.2).eval w))
      (honestAns S S' Hq tq.2 ((pres P S S' tq.2).eval w)) = true := by sorry

theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.post6_apply (n : ℕ) :
    post6 (Data.cons (encode (unary (arPar PD lam mu sigma n).m))
        (Data.cons (encode (unary (arPar PD lam mu sigma n).k))
          (encode ((arPar PD lam mu sigma n).k, (arPar PD lam mu sigma n).m,
            (arPar PD lam mu sigma n).s))),
      encode (unary (arPar PD lam mu sigma n).s)) = (family PD lam mu sigma).pd n := by sorry

nodes.docstring: **The running time of the budgets' routine.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.budCore_time : ∃ c m e, ∀ {W X : ℕ} (lam mu sigma n : ℕ), 1 ≤ X →
    arQ lam mu n ≤ W → lam ≤ W → sigma ≤ W → n ≤ W →
    PRuns W X mu c m e budCore (.cons (encode (lam, mu, sigma)) (encode n))
      (encode (arQ lam mu n, tPcp lam mu n)) := by sorry

nodes.docstring: **The PCP's parameters are dominated**, with the contexts that hold them.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.params_pdom (PD : PcpDecider) (R : Polynomial ℕ) : ∃ c m e, ∀ {W X : ℕ},
    ParamsBound PD R → ∀ (lam mu sigma n : ℕ), 1 ≤ X → arQ lam mu n ≤ W → sigma ≤ W → n ≤ W →
    PDom W X mu c m e (20 * ((arPar PD lam mu sigma n).k + (arPar PD lam mu sigma n).m +
      (arPar PD lam mu sigma n).s) + 20) := by sorry

nodes.docstring: The context after the budgets, `((Q, T), (λ, μ, σ), n)`, is dominated.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.ctxQT_pdom : ∃ c m e, ∀ {W X : ℕ} (lam mu sigma n : ℕ), 1 ≤ X → arQ lam mu n ≤ W →
    lam ≤ W → sigma ≤ W → n ≤ W →
    PDom W X mu c m e (Data.cons (encode (arQ lam mu n, tPcp lam mu n))
      (.cons (encode (lam, mu, sigma)) (encode n))).size := by sorry

theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.parCore_time (PD : PcpDecider) (R : Polynomial ℕ) : ∃ c m e, ∀ {W X : ℕ},
    ParamsBound PD R → ∀ (lam mu sigma n : ℕ), 1 ≤ X →
    arQ lam mu n ≤ W → lam ≤ W → sigma ≤ W → n ≤ W →
    PRuns W X mu c m e (core PD) (.cons (encode (lam, mu, sigma)) (encode n))
      ((family PD lam mu sigma).pd n) := by sorry

nodes.docstring: **The running time of the parameter routine** `parProg`, on the index `n`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.parProg_time (PD : PcpDecider) (R : Polynomial ℕ) : ∃ c m e, ∀ {W X : ℕ},
    ParamsBound PD R → ∀ (lam mu sigma n : ℕ), 1 ≤ X →
    arQ lam mu n ≤ W → lam ≤ W → sigma ≤ W → n ≤ W →
    PRuns W X mu c m e (parProg PD lam mu sigma) (encode n) ((family PD lam mu sigma).pd n) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
The `j`-th coordinate of the `i`-th block of `V_{6,pt}` is the `j`-th coordinate of
`V_{i,pt}`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.Pcp.pt6_block (i : Fin 5) (j : Fin P.m) :
    pt6 P ⟨i * P.m + j, by
      have h1 : (i : ℕ) * P.m ≤ 4 * P.m := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.isLt)
      have h2 : (j : ℕ) < P.m := j.isLt
      simp only [PcpParams.m']
      omega⟩ = .pt i j := by sorry

nodes.docstring: **The running time of the typed answer-reduced sampler.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.typedSampler_time (ℓ : ℕ) (PD : PcpDecider) (R : Polynomial ℕ) : ∃ C M E, ∀ {W : ℕ}
    (S : Sampler (ℓ + 1)) (lam mu sigma n : ℕ), ParamsBound PD R →
    arQ lam mu n ≤ W → lam ≤ W → sigma ≤ W → n ≤ W → esize S.prog ≤ W →
    S.TimeBoundAt n (arQ lam mu n) mu →
    (typedSampler S PD lam mu sigma).TimeBoundAt n ((C * (W + 1) ^ M) ^ (mu + 1))
      (E * (mu + 1)) := by sorry

nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.condFail_OO_le (y : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    condFail (oGame V n B') T.ψ (MAo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (MBo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec) (.oracle, y) (.oracle, y)
      ≤ gcA V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec y + gcB V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec y
        + dis T.ψ ((JA V n P hk S S' check B T y).toPOVM ())
          ((JB V n P hk S S' check B T y).toPOVM ()) := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')

nodes.docstring:
**An oracle and Alice**: the oracle's game check and the disagreement of its first answer
polynomial with Alice's.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.condFail_Oa_le (x : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    condFail (oGame V n B') T.ψ (MAo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (MBo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (.oracle, (roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x)
        (.alice, (roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .alice).eval x)
      ≤ gcA V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x)
        + disPolyA V n P hk S S' check B T 0 x := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')

nodes.docstring: **An oracle and Bob.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.condFail_Ob_le (x : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    condFail (oGame V n B') T.ψ (MAo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (MBo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (.oracle, (roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x)
        (.bob, (roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .bob).eval x)
      ≤ gcA V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x)
        + disPolyA V n P hk S S' check B T 1 x := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')

nodes.docstring: **Alice and an oracle.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.condFail_aO_le (x : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    condFail (oGame V n B') T.ψ (MAo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (MBo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (.alice, (roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .alice).eval x)
        (.oracle, (roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x)
      ≤ gcB V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x)
        + disPolyB V n P hk S S' check B T 0 x := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')

nodes.docstring: **Bob and an oracle.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.condFail_bO_le (x : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    condFail (oGame V n B') T.ψ (MAo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (MBo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (.bob, (roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .bob).eval x)
        (.oracle, (roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x)
      ≤ gcB V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x)
        + disPolyB V n P hk S S' check B T 1 x := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')

nodes.docstring: **Alice and Alice**: the disagreement of the two extracted polynomial measurements.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.condFail_aa_le (y : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    condFail (oGame V n B') T.ψ (MAo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (MBo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec) (.alice, y) (.alice, y)
      ≤ dis T.ψ ((GA1 V n P hk S S' check B T (roleOf 0) 0 y).toPOVM ())
          ((GB1 V n P hk S S' check B T (roleOf 0) 0 y).toPOVM ()) := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')

nodes.docstring: **Alice and Bob** never fail: only the formats are checked.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.condFail_ab_le (y y' : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    condFail (oGame V n B') T.ψ (MAo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (MBo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec) (.alice, y) (.bob, y') ≤ 0 := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')

nodes.docstring: **Bob and Bob**: the disagreement of the two extracted polynomial measurements.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.condFail_bb_le (y : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    condFail (oGame V n B') T.ψ (MAo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (MBo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec) (.bob, y) (.bob, y)
      ≤ dis T.ψ ((GA1 V n P hk S S' check B T (roleOf 1) 1 y).toPOVM ())
          ((GB1 V n P hk S S' check B T (roleOf 1) 1 y).toPOVM ()) := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')

nodes.docstring: **Bob and Alice** never fail: only the formats are checked.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.condFail_ba_le (y y' : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    condFail (oGame V n B') T.ψ (MAo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (MBo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec) (.bob, y) (.alice, y') ≤ 0 := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**A placed outcome whose decoded pair fails the game check is rejected at at least half the
points.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.one_le_two_mul_rejFrac (hgc : PcpSound V n P hk check B' dec)
    (y : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) (f : Poly6 P hk) (hbl : BlockLocal P hk f)
    (hg : ¬ (V.seeded n B').gameCheck (.oracle, y) (decO P hk B' dec f) = true) :
    1 ≤ 2 * rejFrac V n P hk check y f := by sorry

open scoped ComplexOrder
variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')
omit [NeZero P.m]

nodes.docstring:
**The oracle's game check under Alice's `J`**: the outcomes not placed on their blocks, which
disagree with Bob's placed `G`, plus twice the weight of the rejected evaluations.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.gcA_le (hgc : PcpSound V n P hk check B' dec) (x : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    gcA V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x)
      ≤ ∑ i : Fin 5, disPolyA V n P hk S S' check B T i x
        + 2 * gcEvA V n P hk S S' check B T x := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')

nodes.docstring: **The oracle's game check under Bob's `J`**, the mirror image.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.gcB_le (hgc : PcpSound V n P hk check B' dec) (x : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    gcB V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x)
      ≤ ∑ i : Fin 5, disPolyB V n P hk S S' check B T i x
        + 2 * gcEvB V n P hk S S' check B T x := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')

nodes.docstring: **Alice's oracles' game checks**, summed over the oracle halves.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_gcA_le (hgc : PcpSound V n P hk check B' dec) :
    ∑ x, gcA V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x)
      ≤ Fintype.card (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) * (7 * errD V n P hk S S' check B T) := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')

nodes.docstring: **Bob's oracles' game checks**, summed over the oracle halves.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_gcB_le (hgc : PcpSound V n P hk check B' dec) :
    ∑ x, gcB V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x)
      ≤ Fintype.card (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) * (7 * errD V n P hk S S' check B T) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**The failure of a strategy for a typed oracularized game** is the average, over the ordered
pairs of roles and the seed, of its failure at the questions they determine.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.one_sub_povmValue_typed {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {ℓ' : ℕ}
    (L : Player → CL.CLFun CL.𝔽₂ ι (ℓ' + 1)) {A' : Type*} [Fintype A']
    (D' : CL.Detyping.Question Role ι → CL.Detyping.Question Role ι → A' → A' → Bool)
    {dA dB : Type*} [Fintype dA] [DecidableEq dA] [Fintype dB] [DecidableEq dB]
    (ψ : dA × dB → ℂ) (MA : CL.Detyping.Question Role ι → POVM A' dA)
    (MB : CL.Detyping.Question Role ι → POVM A' dB) :
    1 - povmValue (CL.Detyping.typedGame roleGraph roleGraph_nonempty (fun _ => roleFamily L) D')
        ψ MA MB
      = (9 * Fintype.card (ι → CL.𝔽₂) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ z : ι → CL.𝔽₂, ∑ u : Role, ∑ v : Role,
          condFail (CL.Detyping.typedGame roleGraph roleGraph_nonempty (fun _ => roleFamily L) D')
            ψ MA MB (u, (roleFamily L u).eval z) (v, (roleFamily L v).eval z) := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')
omit [NeZero P.m]

nodes.docstring: **The decoded strategy's failure** at a seed, over the nine ordered pairs of roles.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_roles_condFail_le (hgc : PcpSound V n P hk check B' dec)
    (z : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    ∑ u : Role, ∑ v : Role, condFail (oGame V n B') T.ψ (MAo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (MBo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec) (u, (roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) u).eval z)
        (v, (roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) v).eval z)
      ≤ 3 * gcA V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval z)
        + 3 * gcB V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval z)
        + dis T.ψ
            ((JA V n P hk S S' check B T ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval z)).toPOVM ())
            ((JB V n P hk S S' check B T ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval z)).toPOVM ())
        + (disPolyA V n P hk S S' check B T 0 z + disPolyA V n P hk S S' check B T 1 z
          + disPolyB V n P hk S S' check B T 0 z + disPolyB V n P hk S S' check B T 1 z)
        + dis T.ψ ((GA1 V n P hk S S' check B T (roleOf 0) 0
            ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) (roleOf 0)).eval z)).toPOVM ())
            ((GB1 V n P hk S S' check B T (roleOf 0) 0
              ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) (roleOf 0)).eval z)).toPOVM ())
        + dis T.ψ ((GA1 V n P hk S S' check B T (roleOf 1) 1
            ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) (roleOf 1)).eval z)).toPOVM ())
            ((GB1 V n P hk S S' check B T (roleOf 1) 1
              ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) (roleOf 1)).eval z)).toPOVM ()) := by sorry

  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (B' : ℕ)
  (dec : MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (Fq P hk) → Verifier.Answers B')

nodes.docstring:
**The decoded strategy fails the typed oracularized game** with probability at most `6` times
the combined error, given the PCP's soundness in the form `hgc`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.one_sub_povmValue_decoded_le (hgc : PcpSound V n P hk check B' dec) :
    1 - povmValue (oGame V n B') T.ψ (MAo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
        (MBo V n P hk S S' check B T B' dec)
      ≤ 6 * errD V n P hk S S' check B T := by sorry

nodes.docstring: **The prefactor of `δ_sim`** is at most `Z^{3A}` when its argument is at most `Z²`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.simA_mul_rpow_le {M Z : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hZ : 2 ≤ Z) (h : M ≤ Z ^ 2) :
    Simul.simA * (M : ℝ) ^ Simul.simA ≤ (Z : ℝ) ^ (3 * simAN) := by sorry

theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.deltaSim_le_of {q m d r : ℕ} {x x' Pw β E : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x)

nodes.docstring: **The combined error at a typed failure `θ ≤ Kε`**, over a large field.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.errE_le {q m m' Q : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmm : m ≤ m') (hQm : Q ≤ m)
    (hq : (8 * ((Q + 1) * m')) ^ fieldExp ≤ q) {θ ε K : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ : θ ≤ K * ε)
    (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    errE q m m' θ ≤ 39204 * K * ((8 * ((Q + 1) * m') : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (3 * simAN) * ε ^ clB
      + 1 / ((Q : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2
      + 22 * ((8 * ((Q + 1) * m') : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (3 * simAN) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(clB * Q)) := by sorry

nodes.docstring: **Past a threshold, `2^{clB Q}` beats every polynomial in `Q`**, and `Q ≥ 8064`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.exists_threshold_clB (c p : ℕ) : ∃ Q0 : ℕ, ∀ Q : ℕ, Q0 ≤ Q →
    8064 ≤ Q ∧ 177408 * c * (Q : ℝ) ^ (p + 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (clB * Q) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**The error is below the soundness loss**: with `N = λn`, `Q` between `N^μ` and `N^{2μ}` and
past the threshold, the bound of `errE_le` gives `24 √(7 e) ≤ σ^a (N^{μa} ε^{clB/2} +
N^{-μ clB/2})`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sqrt_le_delta {N μ σ Q c p K : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hμ : 1 ≤ μ) (hσ : 1 ≤ σ)
    (hQN : Q ≤ N ^ (2 * μ)) (hNQ : N ^ μ ≤ Q) (hQ8 : 8064 ≤ Q)
    (hc : 177408 * c * (Q : ℝ) ^ (p + 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (clB * Q)) {G e ε : ℝ}
    (hG : G ≤ c * (Q : ℝ) ^ p * (σ : ℝ) ^ p) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε)
    (he : e ≤ 39204 * K * G * ε ^ clB + 1 / ((Q : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2
      + 22 * G * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(clB * Q))) :
    24 * √(7 * e) ≤ (σ : ℝ) ^ (aOf c p K : ℝ) *
      ((N : ℝ) ^ ((μ : ℝ) * aOf c p K) * ε ^ (clB / 2) + (N : ℝ) ^ (-((μ : ℝ) * (clB / 2)))) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**Jensen's inequality for `ε ↦ ε^b`**, `0 ≤ b ≤ 1`, on a finite family with average at most
`E`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Simul.sum_rpow_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {b : ℝ} (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hb1 : b ≤ 1) (ε : ι → ℝ)
    (hε : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ε i) {E : ℝ} (hE : ∑ i, ε i ≤ Fintype.card ι * E) :
    ∑ i, ε i ^ b ≤ Fintype.card ι * E ^ b := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**`δ_sim` averages**: the average of `δ_sim` over a family of failures is at most `δ_sim` of
any bound on their average.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Simul.sum_deltaSim_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (q m d r : ℕ) (ε : ι → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ε i)
    {E : ℝ} (hE : ∑ i, ε i ≤ Fintype.card ι * E) :
    ∑ i, deltaSim q m d r (ε i) ≤ Fintype.card ι * deltaSim q m d r E := by sorry

nodes.docstring: **The parameters are polynomial**: `Z = 8 (Q + 1) m' ≤ zC (Q σ)^{zE}`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.z_le (hR : ParamsBound PD R) {lam mu sigma n : ℕ} (hlam : 1 ≤ lam) (hmu : 1 ≤ mu)
    (hs : 1 ≤ sigma) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    8 * ((arQ lam mu n + 1) * (arPar PD lam mu sigma n).m')
      ≤ zC R * (arQ lam mu n * sigma) ^ zE R := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**Soundness of answer reduction** (`lem:ar-soundness`, the `soundness` clause of the
`AnswerReduction` contract, at any answer bound above the answer cut): `val*` of the
answer-reduced verifier above `1 - ε` gives `val*(𝒱_n) ≥ 1 - δ(ε, n)`, for `n` past a threshold,
with `a` depending only on `R` and `b = clB / 2`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.arVerifier_soundness (R : Polynomial ℕ) (hF : ShoupField PD) (hR : ParamsBound PD R)
    (hL : FieldLarge PD) :
    ∃ (a b : ℝ) (C : ℕ), 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (lam mu sigma n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (B : ℕ), C ≤ n → 2 ≤ n → 1 ≤ lam →
        V.Within n (inBudget lam mu n) → V.decider.size ≤ sigma → 0 < ε →
        cutVal (arPar PD lam mu sigma n) ≤ B →
        1 - ε < (arVerifier PD lam mu sigma V).valStar n B →
        1 - delta a b lam mu sigma n ε ≤ V.valStar n (inAns lam mu n) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**Step 5 at two `Point_6` questions**: acceptance forces the PCP check to pass on both
answers.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.check_of_typedPred (x : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) (w : Coord P → Fq P hk)
    {a b : Verifier.Answers B}
    (h : typedPred V n P hk S S' check B (tq V n P hk S S' (.oracle, ((5 : Fin 6), .point)) x w)
      (tq V n P hk S S' (.oracle, ((5 : Fin 6), .point)) x w) a b = true) :
    check ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x) ((regs6 P).ptOf w) (rd6all P hk B a)
        = true ∧
      check ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x) ((regs6 P).ptOf w) (rd6all P hk B b)
        = true := by sorry

open MIPRE
open MIPRE.AnswerReduction
open Finset MIPRE.CL MIPRE.LIDT MIPRE.SAT MIPRE.AnswerReduction.Pcp
variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B))

nodes.docstring:
**Alice's `J` against the check**: summed over the oracle halves, at most the sixth copy's
extraction error plus `54²` times the typed failure, per oracle half.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_gcEvA_le :
    ∑ x, gcEvA V n P hk S S' check B T x
      ≤ Fintype.card (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) *
        (err6 V n P hk S S' check B T + 2916 * (1 - T.value)) := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B))

nodes.docstring: **Bob's `J` against the check**, the mirror image.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_gcEvB_le :
    ∑ x, gcEvB V n P hk S S' check B T x
      ≤ Fintype.card (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) *
        (err6 V n P hk S S' check B T + 2916 * (1 - T.value)) := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B))

nodes.docstring:
**Any set of type pairs inside the typed failure**: the failures at an injective family of type
pairs, summed over the oracle halves and the PCP vectors, add up to at most the number of type
pairs times the number of vectors times the typed game's failure.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_edges_le (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] (e : ι → ArTy × ArTy) (he : Function.Injective e) :
    ∑ j, ∑ x, ∑ w, edgeFail V n P hk S S' check B T (e j) x w
      ≤ (Fintype.card (ArTy × ArTy) * Fintype.card (Fin (dim V n P) → 𝔽₂)) * (1 - T.value) := by sorry

  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →

nodes.docstring:
**The copy's edges inside the typed failure**: the nine type pairs of copy `i` at role `r`,
summed over the seeds and the samples, weigh at most the typed game's failure.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_copyFail_le (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) (r : Role)
    (i : Fin 5) :
    (Fintype.card (Fq P hk) ^ (Fintype.card (Coord P) - (2 * P.m + 1)) : ℝ) *
        ∑ x₀, ∑ sm,
          copyFail V n P hk S S' check B T r i ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) r).eval x₀) sm
      ≤ (Fintype.card (ArTy × ArTy) * Fintype.card (Fin (dim V n P) → 𝔽₂)) * (1 - T.value) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**The per-seed failures average to at most `324` times the typed failure**, at a role pair
where copy `i` is tested: the copy's nine type pairs are `9 / 54^2 = 1 / 324` of the typed game's
edges, and on them the copy's registers of a uniform vector carry a uniform sample.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_one_sub_value_copyStrategy_le
    (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) {r : Role} {i : Fin 5}
    (hr : LDStep r i) :
    ∑ x₀, (1 - (copyStrategy V n P hk S S' check B T r i
        ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) r).eval x₀)).value)
      ≤ Fintype.card (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) * (324 * (1 - T.value)) := by sorry

  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →

nodes.docstring: **The sixth copy's edges inside the typed failure.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_copyFail6_le (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) :
    (Fintype.card (Fq P hk) ^ (Fintype.card (Coord P) - (2 * P.m' + 1)) : ℝ) *
        ∑ x₀, ∑ sm,
          copyFail6 V n P hk S S' check B T ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x₀) sm
      ≤ (Fintype.card (ArTy × ArTy) * Fintype.card (Fin (dim V n P) → 𝔽₂)) * (1 - T.value) := by sorry

nodes.docstring: **The sixth copy's per-seed failures average to at most `324` times the typed failure.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_one_sub_value_copyStrategy6_le
    (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B)) :
    ∑ x₀, (1 - (copyStrategy6 V n P hk S S' check B T
        ((roleFamily (V.sampler.cl n) .oracle).eval x₀)).value)
      ≤ Fintype.card (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) * (324 * (1 - T.value)) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**From evaluations to polynomials, Alice's `J`**: at each oracle half, the outcome-level
disagreement is at most the evaluated one, averaged over the PCP vectors, plus `m' d / q`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.disPolyA_le (i : Fin 5) (x : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    disPolyA V n P hk S S' check B T i x
      ≤ (∑ w, dis T.ψ (JAe V n P hk S S' check B T (blk P i) (x, w))
          (GBe V n P hk S S' check B T i (x, w))) / Fintype.card (Coord P → Fq P hk)
        + errSZ P hk := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B))

nodes.docstring: **From evaluations to polynomials, Bob's `J`.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.disPolyB_le (i : Fin 5) (x : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) :
    disPolyB V n P hk S S' check B T i x
      ≤ (∑ w, dis T.ψ (GAe V n P hk S S' check B T i (x, w))
          (JBe V n P hk S S' check B T (blk P i) (x, w))) / Fintype.card (Coord P → Fq P hk)
        + errSZ P hk := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B))

nodes.docstring: **Summed over the oracle halves**, Alice's `J` against Bob's placed `G`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_disPolyA_le (i : Fin 5) :
    ∑ x, disPolyA V n P hk S S' check B T i x
      ≤ Fintype.card (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) * (11 * (err6 V n P hk S S' check B T
        + 2916 * (1 - T.value) + err1 V n P hk S S' check B T) + errSZ P hk) := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ) (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B))

nodes.docstring: **Summed over the oracle halves**, Alice's placed `G` against Bob's `J`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_disPolyB_le (i : Fin 5) :
    ∑ x, disPolyB V n P hk S S' check B T i x
      ≤ Fintype.card (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) * (11 * (err1 V n P hk S S' check B T
        + 2916 * (1 - T.value) + err6 V n P hk S S' check B T) + errSZ P hk) := by sorry

  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ)

nodes.docstring: The mirror image, with the sixth copy's point asked to Alice.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.rd_eq_of_typedPred_prime (i : Fin 5) (x : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) (w : Coord P → Fq P hk)
    {a b : Verifier.Answers B}
    (h : typedPred V n P hk S S' check B (tq V n P hk S S' (.oracle, ((5 : Fin 6), .point)) x w)
      (tq V n P hk S S' (roleOf i, (i.castSucc, .point)) x w) a b = true) :
    rd6 P hk B (blk P i) a = rd1 P hk B i b := by sorry

  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ)

nodes.docstring: **Alice's point of copy `i` against Bob's extracted polynomial**, from the extraction.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_dis_MA1_GBe_le (i : Fin 5) :
    ∑ p, dis T.ψ (MA1 V n P hk S S' check B T i p) (GBe V n P hk S S' check B T i p)
      ≤ Fintype.card (Idx V n P hk) *
        Simul.deltaSim (Fintype.card (Fq P hk)) P.m dPcp 1 (324 * (1 - T.value)) := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ)
variable (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B))

nodes.docstring: **Alice's extracted polynomial of copy `i` against Bob's point**, from the extraction.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_dis_GAe_MB1_le (i : Fin 5) :
    ∑ p, dis T.ψ (GAe V n P hk S S' check B T i p) (MB1 V n P hk S S' check B T i p)
      ≤ Fintype.card (Idx V n P hk) *
        Simul.deltaSim (Fintype.card (Fq P hk)) P.m dPcp 1 (324 * (1 - T.value)) := by sorry

open Finset MIPRE.CL MIPRE.LIDT MIPRE.SAT MIPRE.AnswerReduction.Pcp
variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ)
variable (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B))

nodes.docstring: **Alice's extracted `j`-th polynomial of the sixth copy against Bob's `Point_6`.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_dis_JAe_MB6_le (j : Fin (P.m' + 6)) :
    ∑ p, dis T.ψ (JAe V n P hk S S' check B T j p) (MB6 V n P hk S S' check B T j p)
      ≤ Fintype.card (Idx V n P hk) *
        Simul.deltaSim (Fintype.card (Fq P hk)) P.m' dPcp (P.m' + 6) (324 * (1 - T.value)) := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ)
variable (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B))

nodes.docstring: **Alice's `Point_6` against Bob's extracted `j`-th polynomial of the sixth copy.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.sum_dis_MA6_JBe_le (j : Fin (P.m' + 6)) :
    ∑ p, dis T.ψ (MA6 V n P hk S S' check B T j p) (JBe V n P hk S S' check B T j p)
      ≤ Fintype.card (Idx V n P hk) *
        Simul.deltaSim (Fintype.card (Fq P hk)) P.m' dPcp (P.m' + 6) (324 * (1 - T.value)) := by sorry

variable {ℓ : ℕ} (V : Verifier (ℓ + 1)) (n : ℕ) (P : PcpParams) (hk : 1 ≤ P.k)
  [NeZero P.m] {hm : P.m ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)} {hm' : P.m' ∣ Fintype.card (Fq P hk)}
  (S : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m hm) (S' : LIDT.CL.Sel (Fq P hk) P.m' hm')
  (check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) → (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) →
    Bool) (B : ℕ)
variable (T : TensorProductStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check B))

nodes.docstring:
**Detyping soundness for answer reduction**: the typed strategy loses at most a factor
`16^{54}` in failure probability.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.typedStrategy_value_ge (R : TensorProductStrategy
    ((arVerifier PD lam mu sigma V).game n (cutVal (arPar PD lam mu sigma n))))
    {ε : ℝ} (hR : 1 - ε ≤ R.value) :
    1 - (16 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ArTy * ε ≤ (typedStrategy PD lam mu sigma V n R).value := by sorry

theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.StageProg.copyAnswer_marginal (τ : LIDT.CL.Ty) {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (v : Coord P → ((shoupBinField k hk)).carrier)
    (y : BitStr) :

nodes.docstring:
**The oracularized predicate's checks are the consistency of the data**, on a question pair
read off one seed, when every accepted pair's proof is good.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.consistent_of_oaccepts
    (hpf : ∀ x (a b : Verifier.Answers B), (V.seeded n B).D ((V.sampler.cl n .alice).eval x)
      ((V.sampler.cl n .bob).eval x) a b = true → ProofGood hk check x a.1 b.1 (pfOf x a.1 b.1))
    (r₁ r₂ : Role) (x₀ : Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) {u v : OAns (Verifier.Answers B)}
    (h : (V.seeded n B).oaccepts ((V.seeded n B).oquestion r₁ x₀) ((V.seeded n B).oquestion r₂ x₀)
      u v = true) :
    Consistent r₁ r₂ (hdata V n P hk pfOf r₁ ((V.seeded n B).oquestion r₁ x₀).2 u)
      (hdata V n P hk pfOf r₂ ((V.seeded n B).oquestion r₂ x₀).2 v) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**Completeness of the typed answer-reduced game**: a value-`1` PCC strategy of `𝒱_n`, and
good PCP proofs of the pairs it accepts, give a value-`1` PCC strategy of the doubled typed game
at any answer cut above `32 (k + 1)(m' + 7)^2`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.AnswerReduction.exists_typedGame_perfectPCC
    {check : (Fin (V.sampler.dim n) → 𝔽₂) → (Fin P.m' → Fq P hk) →
      (Fin (P.m' + 6) → Fq P hk) → Bool} (Bout : ℕ)
    (hBout : 32 * ((P.k + 1) * (P.m' + 7) * (P.m' + 7)) ≤ Bout) (hV : V.HasPerfectPCC n B)
    (hpf : ∀ x (a b : Verifier.Answers B), (V.seeded n B).D ((V.sampler.cl n .alice).eval x)
      ((V.sampler.cl n .bob).eval x) a b = true → ProofGood hk check x a.1 b.1 (pfOf x a.1 b.1)) :
    ∃ R : SyncStrategy (typedGame V n P hk S S' check Bout).doubled, R.IsPCC ∧ R.value = 1 := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**The pivot set of a coordinate line is the coordinate.** The dimension sequence of
`span {eᵢ}` is `1` up to `i` and `0` after it, so it drops exactly once, at `i`; and a line
has one pivot in all, by `card_pivots`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Adapter.pivots_line (i : Fin n) :
    pivots (span F {(Pi.single i 1 : Fin n → F)}) = {i} := by sorry

direction's first nonzero coordinate is `1` and the base point vanishes there, which is what
makes reading off that one coordinate correct.

theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Adapter.param_through_eq_of_mem {v : Fin n → F} (hv : ∃ j, v j ≠ 0) (u : Fin n → F) (t : F) :
    Line.param (Line.through u v) ((Line.through u v).1 + t • (Line.through u v).2) = t := by sorry

nodes.docstring: **B's point measurement, likewise.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Adapter.val_mats_pointPOVMB_adapted (σc : Seed F m)
    (S : TensorProductStrategy (clGame (d := d) (ldc := 1) hm)) (u : Point F m) (f : F) :
    ((CL.pointPOVMB S u).mats f).val
      = ((pointPOVMB (adapted σc S) (revPoint u)).mats f).val := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**Soundness of the seeded CL test at `ldc = 1`, by reduction to the canonical-line test.**

A strategy for `clGame` passing with probability at least `1 - ε` has point measurements
consistent, up to `lidtError m d q k (3m·ε)`, with the evaluations of a single measurement with
low-individual-degree outcomes --- one per player, the two consistent with each other. The
factor `3m` is the push-forward cost of the adapter (`pushforward_le`); the `k` is free subject to
`k ≥ 400md`, exactly as in the canonical-line theorem.

This is the `ldc = 1` case of `thm:lidt-cl-soundness` *with the error in the canonical-line
form*. Turning `lidtError m d q k (3m ε)` into the `δ_CL` the blueprint asks for is a separate
arithmetic obligation, and `ldc > 1` is `lem:lidt-ldc`, a separate piece of work on top.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Adapter.clSoundness_ldc_one
    (S : TensorProductStrategy (clGame (d := d) (ldc := 1) hm)) (ε : ℝ) (hS : 1 - ε ≤ S.value)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 400 * m * d ≤ k) (hk0 : 0 < k) :
    ∃ GA : ProjectiveMeasurement Unit (LowIndDegPoly (F := F) (m := m) (d := d))
        (Matrix (Fin S.dA) (Fin S.dA) ℂ),
    ∃ GB : ProjectiveMeasurement Unit (LowIndDegPoly (F := F) (m := m) (d := d))
        (Matrix (Fin S.dB) (Fin S.dB) ℂ),
      inconsistency (uniform (Point F m)) S.ψ (CL.pointPOVMA S) (evalPOVM GB)
          ≤ lidtError m d (Fintype.card F) k (3 * m * ε) ∧
        inconsistency (uniform (Point F m)) S.ψ (evalPOVM GA) (CL.pointPOVMB S)
          ≤ lidtError m d (Fintype.card F) k (3 * m * ε) ∧
        inconsistency (uniform Unit) S.ψ (fun _ => GA.toPOVM ()) (fun _ => GB.toPOVM ())
          ≤ lidtError m d (Fintype.card F) k (3 * m * ε) := by sorry

differ by `shiftOf ℓ` times the direction and the directions by the scale `c`, so the point at
the target's parameter `t` sits at the source's `(t + shiftOf ℓ) / c`; `reparam c⁻¹ (c⁻¹ · shiftOf ℓ)`
undoes exactly that. This is where `lineParam_smul` and the general two-parameter `reparam` are
used.

nodes.docstring:
**The direction pins the `q`-exponent.** A sample producing the line has `j` at least the
reversal of `diagIdx ℓ`: its direction vanishes above `j`, hence so does the line's, hence the
*reversed* direction vanishes below `rev j`, so its first nonzero coordinate is at least
`rev j`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Adapter.le_rev_diagIdx_of_questions {ℓ : Line F m} {u : Point F m} {j : Fin m}
    {v : Fin ((j : ℕ) + 1) → F} (hℓ : ∃ k, ℓ.2 k ≠ 0)
    (hs : (Sample.diag false u j v).questions
      = ((Question.diagLine ℓ : Question F m), Question.point u)) :
    ((Fin.rev (diagIdx ℓ) : ℕ)) ≤ (j : ℕ) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**At most `m q` samples produce a given diagonal line against a given point.** A sample is
pinned by its `j` together with the scalar relating its direction to the line's, and there are
`m` values of the first and `q` of the second.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Adapter.card_filter_diag_le {ℓ : Line F m} (hℓ : ∃ k, ℓ.2 k ≠ 0) (u : Point F m) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Sample F m =>
        s.questions = ((Question.diagLine ℓ : Question F m), Question.point u))).card
      ≤ m * Fintype.card F := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**Every sample producing a given diagonal line against a point has weight at most
`1/(6 m q^m q^{rev (diagIdx ℓ) + 1})`.** This is where the `q`-exponent of the bound is fixed:
`le_rev_diagIdx_of_questions` says a contributing sample's `j` is at least `rev (diagIdx ℓ)`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Adapter.weight_le_of_questions_diag {ℓ : Line F m} (hℓ : ∃ k, ℓ.2 k ≠ 0) {u : Point F m}
    {s : Sample F m} (hsq : s.questions = ((Question.diagLine ℓ : Question F m),
      Question.point u)) :
    s.weight ≤ 1 / (6 * m * Fintype.card (Point F m) *
      (Fintype.card F : ℝ) ^ ((Fin.rev (diagIdx ℓ) : ℕ) + 1)) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
The samples of the seeded test that ask the same point twice include one for every seed and
every raw direction, so there are at least `q · q^m` of them.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Adapter.card_filter_clPoint_ge (hm : m ∣ Fintype.card F) (xp : Point F m) :
    Fintype.card F * Fintype.card (Point F m)
      ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun sm : CL.Sample F m =>
          (sm.question hm sm.tyA, sm.question hm sm.tyB)
            = ((CL.Question.point xp : CL.Question F m), CL.Question.point xp))).card := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
And for a diagonal line against a point, provided the direction really does vanish below the
seed's block --- which it must, for the question to be in the seeded test's support. There is one
sample for every completion of the direction *below* that block, hence at least `q^{χ s}`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Adapter.card_filter_clDiag_ge (hm : m ∣ Fintype.card F) (xp : Point F m) (s₀ : F)
    (w : Point F m) (hw : ∀ k : Fin m, (k : ℕ) < ((chi hm s₀ : ℕ)) → w k = 0) :
    Fintype.card F ^ ((chi hm s₀ : ℕ))
      ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun sm : CL.Sample F m =>
          (sm.question hm sm.tyA, sm.question hm sm.tyB)
            = ((CL.Question.dline (rep w xp) s₀ w : CL.Question F m),
                CL.Question.point xp))).card := by sorry

nodes.docstring: **Count times weight times count.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Adapter.sum_sum_le_card_mul {S ι : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (cond : S → ι → Prop) [∀ σ i, Decidable (cond σ i)]
    (T : Finset ι) (B : ℝ) (M : ℕ)
    (hsub : ∀ σ i, cond σ i → i ∈ T) (hB : ∀ i ∈ T, w i ≤ B)
    (hM : ∀ i ∈ T, (Finset.univ.filter (fun σ : S => cond σ i)).card ≤ M) :
    (∑ σ : S, ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => cond σ i), w i)
      ≤ (T.card : ℝ) * (B * M) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**The base point the contributing sample forces.** If anything contributes to an
axis-parallel question against a point, the question is the one the *seeded* test itself would
have asked at that point and seed: `revPoint_rep_single` unreverses the adapter's base point.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Adapter.base_of_qmapS_axis (hm : m ∣ Fintype.card F) (σc : Seed F m)
    {u₀ : Point F m} {s₀ : F} {yp : Point F m} {s : Sample F m}
    (h1 : qmapS hm σc s.questions.1 = CL.Question.aline u₀ s₀)
    (h2 : qmapS hm σc s.questions.2 = CL.Question.point yp) :
    u₀ = CL.rep (Pi.single (chi hm s₀) 1) yp := by sorry

    (hw : w ≠ 0) (yp : Point F m) :
    (∑ σc : Seed F m,
        ∑ x' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x' => qmapS hm σc x' = CL.Question.dline u₀ s₀ w),
        ∑ y' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y' => qmapS hm σc y' = CL.Question.point yp),
          (lidtGame F m d).μ x' y')
      ≤ (Fintype.card (Seed F m) : ℝ) *
          (3 * m * (clGame (d := d) (ldc := ldc) hm).μ
            (CL.Question.dline u₀ s₀ w) (CL.Question.point yp)) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**The push-forward bound, assembled.** The average over the family of the canonical-line
test's mass on the fibre of a seeded question pair is at most `3m` times the seeded test's mass
on it. This is the hypothesis `exists_one_sub_value_adapt_le` asks for, and `3m` is the constant
`thm:lidt-cl-soundness` multiplies its `ε` by --- polynomial in `m`, as `δ_CL` allows, and free
of `q`, which it does not.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Adapter.pushforward_le (hm : m ∣ Fintype.card F) (x y : CL.Question F m) :
    (∑ σc : Seed F m, ∑ x' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x' => qmapS hm σc x' = x),
        ∑ y' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y' => qmapS hm σc y' = y), (lidtGame F m d).μ x' y')
      ≤ (Fintype.card (Seed F m) : ℝ) *
          (3 * m * (clGame (d := d) (ldc := ldc) hm).μ x y) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Our inconsistency of two POVM families agrees with MIPStarRE's consistency error of
two complete submeasurement families, when questions and outcomes are matched along
equivalences `qe`, `e` and the state is the pure state of a strategy.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Bridge.inconsistency_eq_bipartiteConsError (S : TensorProductStrategy (lidtGame F m d))
    {X X' α α' : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype X'] [DecidableEq X'] [Nonempty X'] [Fintype α]
    [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α']
    (qe : X ≃ X') (e : α ≃ α')
    (M : X → POVM α (Fin S.dA)) (N : X → POVM α (Fin S.dB))
    (A : IdxSubMeas X' α' (Fin S.dA)) (B : IdxSubMeas X' α' (Fin S.dB))
    (hA : ∀ x', (A x').total = 1) (hB : ∀ x', (B x').total = 1)
    (hM : ∀ x a, ((M x).mats a).val = (A (qe x)).outcome (e a))
    (hN : ∀ x a, ((N x).mats a).val = (B (qe x)).outcome (e a)) :
    inconsistency (uniform X) S.ψ M N =
      bipartiteConsError (toProjStrat S).state (uniformDistribution X') A B := by sorry

nodes.docstring: The soundness theorem, assembled from the MIPStarRE main theorem.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Bridge.soundness (S : TensorProductStrategy (lidtGame F m d)) (ε : ℝ) (hS : 1 - ε ≤ S.value)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 400 * m * d ≤ k) (hk0 : 0 < k) :
    ∃ GA : ProjectiveMeasurement Unit (LowIndDegPoly (F := F) (m := m) (d := d))
        (Matrix (Fin S.dA) (Fin S.dA) ℂ),
    ∃ GB : ProjectiveMeasurement Unit (LowIndDegPoly (F := F) (m := m) (d := d))
        (Matrix (Fin S.dB) (Fin S.dB) ℂ),
      inconsistency (uniform (Point F m)) S.ψ (pointPOVMA S) (evalPOVM GB) ≤
          lidtError m d (Fintype.card F) k ε ∧
        inconsistency (uniform (Point F m)) S.ψ (evalPOVM GA) (pointPOVMB S) ≤
          lidtError m d (Fintype.card F) k ε ∧
        inconsistency (uniform Unit) S.ψ (fun _ => GA.toPOVM ()) (fun _ => GB.toPOVM ()) ≤
          lidtError m d (Fintype.card F) k ε := by sorry

nodes.docstring: The parameter of the base point on its canonical presentation.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Line.param_through (u v : Point F m) :
    (through u v).param u =
      if h : ∃ j, v j ≠ 0 then u (Fin.find (fun j => v j ≠ 0) h) else 0 := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
The MIPStarRE failure probability is the weighted sum of the branch defects over our
samples.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Bridge.failure_eq_sum (S : TensorProductStrategy (lidtGame F m d)) :
    (toProjStrat S).lowIndividualDegreeFailureProbability = ∑ s : Sample F m, s.weight * mdef S s := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**The pointwise bound.** At a fixed `y`, answer `b` and outcome `g`, the combined answer and
`g(·, y)` agree at a uniform `x` with probability at most: one if the extracted tuple is `b`; one
if `g` is not exactly `x`-linear and its forbidden coefficient vanishes at `y`; and `K d / q`
otherwise.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Simul.agreeX_le (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hr : r ≤ K) (g : LowIndDegPoly (F := F) (m := K + m) (d := d))
    (y : Point F m) (b : Fin r → F) :
    agreeX hd g y b
      ≤ (if extEval hd hr g y = b then 1 else 0) + K * d / Fintype.card F + badInd hd g y := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**The weighted bound.** For nonnegative weights `β y b g` whose sum over the answer `b` does
not depend on `y` and totals one over the outcomes, the average agreement of the combined answer
exceeds the average agreement of the extracted tuple by at most `(K + m) d / q`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Simul.sum_agreeX_le (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hr : r ≤ K)
    (β : Point F m → (Fin r → F) → LowIndDegPoly (F := F) (m := K + m) (d := d) → ℝ)
    (hβ0 : ∀ y b g, 0 ≤ β y b g) (w : LowIndDegPoly (F := F) (m := K + m) (d := d) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ y g, ∑ b, β y b g = w g) (hw1 : ∑ g, w g = 1) :
    ∑ y : Point F m, uniform (Point F m) y * ∑ b, ∑ g, β y b g * agreeX hd g y b
      ≤ ∑ y : Point F m, uniform (Point F m) y *
          ∑ b, ∑ g, β y b g * (if extEval hd hr g y = b then 1 else 0)
        + (K + m) * d / Fintype.card F := by sorry

nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Simul.inconsistency_extract_right_le (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hr : r ≤ K) {ψ : dA × dB → ℂ}
    (hψ : star ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ = 1) (A : Point F m → POVM (Fin r → F) dA)
    (R : POVM (LowIndDegPoly (F := F) (m := K + m) (d := d)) dB) :
    inconsistency (uniform (Point F m)) ψ A (fun y => R.map fun g => extEval hd hr g y)
      ≤ inconsistency (uniform (Point F (K + m))) ψ
          (fun u => (A (yOf u)).map fun b => (linPoly hd (padB b)).eval (xOf u))
          (fun u => R.map fun g => g.eval u)
        + (K + m) * d / Fintype.card F := by sorry

nodes.docstring: **The extraction bound, the extracted measurement on the first party.**
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Simul.inconsistency_extract_left_le (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hr : r ≤ K) {ψ : dA × dB → ℂ}
    (hψ : star ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ = 1) (R : POVM (LowIndDegPoly (F := F) (m := K + m) (d := d)) dA)
    (B : Point F m → POVM (Fin r → F) dB) :
    inconsistency (uniform (Point F m)) ψ (fun y => R.map fun g => extEval hd hr g y) B
      ≤ inconsistency (uniform (Point F (K + m))) ψ
          (fun u => R.map fun g => g.eval u)
          (fun u => (B (yOf u)).map fun b => (linPoly hd (padB b)).eval (xOf u))
        + (K + m) * d / Fintype.card F := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
**From the single-codeword conclusions to the simultaneous ones** (the paper's Step 4). If the
two players' measurements `RA`, `RB` of polynomials in the `K + m` variables satisfy the three
conclusions of the single-codeword theorem against the combined point measurements, with error
`δ`, then their extractions satisfy the three conclusions of the simultaneous theorem against the
original point measurements, with error `δ + (K + m) d / q` for the two point conclusions and `δ`
for the full-tuple one.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LIDT.Simul.extracted_conclusions (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hr : r ≤ K) {ψ : dA × dB → ℂ}
    (hψ : star ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ = 1) (A : Point F m → POVM (Fin r → F) dA)
    (B : Point F m → POVM (Fin r → F) dB)
    (RA : ProjectiveMeasurement Unit (LowIndDegPoly (F := F) (m := K + m) (d := d))
      (Matrix dA dA ℂ))
    (RB : ProjectiveMeasurement Unit (LowIndDegPoly (F := F) (m := K + m) (d := d))
      (Matrix dB dB ℂ)) {δ : ℝ}
    (h1 : inconsistency (uniform (Point F (K + m))) ψ (combPOVM hd A) (evalPOVM RB) ≤ δ)
    (h2 : inconsistency (uniform (Point F (K + m))) ψ (evalPOVM RA) (combPOVM hd B) ≤ δ)
    (h3 : inconsistency (uniform Unit) ψ (fun _ => RA.toPOVM ()) (fun _ => RB.toPOVM ()) ≤ δ) :
    inconsistency (uniform (Point F m)) ψ A (evalTuplePOVM (extractPM hd hr RB))
        ≤ δ + (K + m) * d / Fintype.card F ∧
      inconsistency (uniform (Point F m)) ψ (evalTuplePOVM (extractPM hd hr RA)) B
        ≤ δ + (K + m) * d / Fintype.card F ∧
      inconsistency (uniform Unit) ψ (fun _ => (extractPM hd hr RA).toPOVM ())
        (fun _ => (extractPM hd hr RB).toPOVM ()) ≤ δ := by sorry

weighted sum of the pulled-back family.  This is the `Distribution` analogue of

    ∑ b ∈ (𝒟.map e).support, (𝒟.map e).weight b • f b =
      ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a • f (e a) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
An average of effects against a sub-probability distribution is again bounded
above by the identity operator.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_le_one_of_weight_sum_le_one {α : Type*}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (f : α → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)
    (h𝒟 : ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a ≤ 1)
    (hf : ∀ a, f a ≤ 1) :
    averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 f ≤ 1 := by sorry

theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_add {α : Type*} (𝒟 : Distribution α) (f g : α → Error) :

nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_sum {α β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (f : α → β → Error) :
    avgOver 𝒟 (fun a => ∑ b : β, f a b) =
      ∑ b : β, avgOver 𝒟 (fun a => f a b) := by sorry

nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_congr {α : Type*} (𝒟 : Distribution α)
    (f g : α → Error) (h : ∀ a, f a = g a) :
    avgOver 𝒟 f = avgOver 𝒟 g := by sorry

    (f g : α → Error) (h : ∀ a, a ∈ 𝒟.support → f a ≤ g a) :
    avgOver 𝒟 f ≤ avgOver 𝒟 g := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
For two probability distributions, total variation is the total positive
part of the signed weight difference `ν - μ`.

This is the finite-distribution identity
`(1 / 2) * ∑ |μ(a)-ν(a)| = ∑ max 0 (ν(a)-μ(a))`, written for the
project `Distribution` representation.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.totalVariationDistance_eq_sum_max_sub {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (μ ν : Distribution α) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (hν : ν.IsProbability) :
    totalVariationDistance μ ν =
      ∑ a ∈ μ.support ∪ ν.support, max 0 (ν.weight a - μ.weight a) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
A `[0,1]`-valued function has expectations over two probability
distributions differing by at most their total variation distance.

The statement is oriented for replacement estimates: averaging against `ν` is
bounded by averaging against `μ`, plus the finite total-variation distance
between the two distributions.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_le_avgOver_add_totalVariationDistance {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (μ ν : Distribution α) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (hν : ν.IsProbability)
    (f : α → Error)
    (hf_nonneg : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a)
    (hf_le_one : ∀ a, f a ≤ 1) :
    avgOver ν f ≤ avgOver μ f + totalVariationDistance μ ν := by sorry

theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_uniform_le_one {α : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : α → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (hf : ∀ a, f a ≤ 1) :
    averageOperatorOverDistribution (uniformDistribution α) f ≤ 1 := by sorry

nodes.docstring: A uniform average is bounded by any pointwise upper bound.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_uniform_le_const {α : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    (f : α → Error) (δ : Error) (hf : ∀ a, f a ≤ δ) :
    avgOver (uniformDistribution α) f ≤ δ := by sorry

nodes.docstring: Reindexing a uniform average along an equivalence preserves its value.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_uniform_equiv
    {α β : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β]
    (e : α ≃ β) (f : α → Error) :
    avgOver (uniformDistribution α) f =
      avgOver (uniformDistribution β) (fun b => f (e.symm b)) := by sorry

theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_uniform_prod
    {α β : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β]
    (f : α → β → Error) :
    avgOver (uniformDistribution (α × β)) (fun ab => f ab.1 ab.2) =
      avgOver (uniformDistribution α)
        (fun a => avgOver (uniformDistribution β) (fun b => f a b)) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Pull a finite sum through a uniform average and express it as a uniform
average over the product, with the cardinality of the summed type as the
normalizing factor.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_uniform_sum_eq_card_mul_prod
    {α β : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β]
    (f : α → β → Error) :
    avgOver (uniformDistribution α) (fun a => ∑ b : β, f a b) =
      (Fintype.card β : Error) *
        avgOver (uniformDistribution (α × β)) (fun ab => f ab.1 ab.2) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
A finite-support uniform module-valued average is the corresponding uniform
average over the support subtype.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformOnFinset_sum_smul_eq_subtype {α M : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module Error M]
    (s : Finset α) [Nonempty {a : α // a ∈ s}] (f : α → M) :
    ∑ a ∈ (Distribution.uniformOnFinset s).support,
        (Distribution.uniformOnFinset s).weight a • f a =
      ∑ a ∈ (uniformDistribution {a : α // a ∈ s}).support,
        (uniformDistribution {a : α // a ∈ s}).weight a • f a.1 := by sorry

      ∑ a ∈ (uniformDistribution {a : α // p a}).support,

nodes.docstring:
A uniform module-valued average over a filtered finite type may be reindexed
by any finite seed type equivalent to the predicate subtype.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformOnFinset_filter_sum_smul_equiv {α β M : Type*}
    [Fintype α] (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module Error M]
    (e : β ≃ {a : α // p a}) (f : α → M) :
    ∑ a ∈ (Distribution.uniformOnFinset (Finset.univ.filter p)).support,
        (Distribution.uniformOnFinset (Finset.univ.filter p)).weight a • f a =
      ∑ b ∈ (uniformDistribution β).support,
        (uniformDistribution β).weight b • f (e b).1 := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
`ev` commutes with the real scalar action on operators.

This is the real-scalar form of `ev_scale`; it is convenient when expanding
operator averages, whose weights act by the real scalar action before being
coerced to complex matrix scalars.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.ev_real_smul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ψ : QuantumState ι) (c : Error) (X : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    ev ψ (c • X) = c * ev ψ X := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Triangle inequality for normalized trace of PSD-weighted quadratic forms.

For PSD `ρ`, the real part of `τ(ρ (D₁ + D₂)ᴴ(D₁ + D₂))` is bounded by twice
the sum of the corresponding quadratic forms for `D₁` and `D₂`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.normalizedTrace_triangle {n : Type*} [Fintype n]
    (ρ D₁ D₂ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hρ : ρ.PosSemidef) :
    Complex.re (MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (ρ * ((D₁ + D₂)ᴴ * (D₁ + D₂)))) ≤
      2 * (Complex.re (MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (ρ * (D₁ᴴ * D₁))) +
           Complex.re (MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (ρ * (D₂ᴴ * D₂)))) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Operator-level triangle inequality for expectation of squared differences:
`E[(X-Z)ᴴ(X-Z)] ≤ 2*(E[(X-Y)ᴴ(X-Y)] + E[(Y-Z)ᴴ(Y-Z)])`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.ev_diff_triangle {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ψ : QuantumState ι) (X Y Z : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    ev ψ ((X - Z)ᴴ * (X - Z)) ≤
    2 * (ev ψ ((X - Y)ᴴ * (X - Y)) +
         ev ψ ((Y - Z)ᴴ * (Y - Z))) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Three-vector version of the normalized-trace triangle inequality.

If a difference is decomposed as three successive differences, its squared norm
is bounded by `3` times the sum of the three squared norms. This is the `k = 3`
case of the paper's `prop:triangle-inequality-for-vectors-squared`, and it is
used by the Step 6 projectivization chain in `inductive_step.tex:154--158`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.normalizedTrace_triangle_three {n : Type*} [Fintype n]
    (ρ D₁ D₂ D₃ : Matrix n n ℂ) (hρ : ρ.PosSemidef) :
    Complex.re (MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace
        (ρ * (((D₁ + D₂ + D₃)ᴴ) * (D₁ + D₂ + D₃)))) ≤
      3 * (Complex.re (MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (ρ * (D₁ᴴ * D₁))) +
        Complex.re (MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (ρ * (D₂ᴴ * D₂))) +
        Complex.re (MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace (ρ * (D₃ᴴ * D₃)))) := by sorry

nodes.docstring: `ev` distributes over finite sums.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.ev_finset_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {α : Type*} (ψ : QuantumState ι) (s : Finset α)
    (f : α → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    ev ψ (∑ a ∈ s, f a) = ∑ a ∈ s, ev ψ (f a) := by sorry

Jensen inequality for the quadratic form: for a finite family of operators,
`ev ψ ((∑ Xᵢ)ᴴ * (∑ Xᵢ)) ≤ n * ∑ ev ψ (XᵢᴴXᵢ)`.

    ev ψ ((∑ a, X a)ᴴ * (∑ a, X a)) ≤
      (Fintype.card α : ℝ) * ∑ a, ev ψ ((X a)ᴴ * X a) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Bipartite-tensor Cauchy–Schwarz for state expectations.

For PSD operators `M`, `T` and arbitrary operators `X`, `Y`,
`(ev ψ (opTensor (Xᴴ M Y) T))² ≤ ev ψ (opTensor (Xᴴ M X) T) *
ev ψ (opTensor (Yᴴ M Y) T)`.

The proof factors `M = √M · √M`, `T = √T · √T` (continuous functional calculus
square roots) and applies `ev_cauchy_schwarz` to
`opTensor (√M · X) √T` and `opTensor (√M · Y) √T`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.ev_opTensor_sandwich_cauchy_schwarz
    {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [DecidableEq ι₁] [Fintype ι₂] [DecidableEq ι₂]
    (ψ : QuantumState (ι₁ × ι₂))
    (X Y M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι₁)
    (T : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι₂)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    (ev ψ (opTensor (Xᴴ * M * Y) T)) ^ 2 ≤
      ev ψ (opTensor (Xᴴ * M * X) T) * ev ψ (opTensor (Yᴴ * M * Y) T) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Pointwise real-weight formula for a finite push-forward probability mass
function.  This is the finite real-valued form of `PMF.map_apply`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem PMF.map_apply_toReal {α β : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p : PMF α) (e : α → β) (b : β) :
    ((p.map e) b).toReal = ∑ a : α, (if b = e a then (p a).toReal else 0) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
A finite PMF-weighted sum against a push-forward is the corresponding
PMF-weighted sum of the pulled-back family.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem PMF.map_sum_smul {α β M : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module MIPStarRE.LDT.Error M]
    (p : PMF α) (e : α → β) (f : β → M) :
    ∑ b : β, ((p.map e) b).toReal • f b =
      ∑ a : α, (p a).toReal • f (e a) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
A finite PMF-weighted sum against a monadic composition is the iterated
PMF-weighted sum.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem PMF.bind_sum_smul {α β M : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module MIPStarRE.LDT.Error M]
    (p : PMF α) (q : α → PMF β) (f : β → M) :
    ∑ b : β, ((p.bind q) b).toReal • f b =
      ∑ a : α, (p a).toReal • ∑ b : β, (q a b).toReal • f b := by sorry

The uniform probability mass function on a product is the monadic
composition of the two coordinate-uniform probability mass functions.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem PMF.uniformOfFintype_prod_eq_bind
    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty β] :
    PMF.uniformOfFintype (α × β) =
      (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).bind
        (fun a => (PMF.uniformOfFintype β).map fun b => (a, b)) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Jensen's inequality for the concave power `x ↦ x ^ (1 / n)`, stated for a
finite probability mass function.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem PMF.sum_rpow_one_div_le_rpow_sum {α : Type*}
    [Fintype α]
    (p : PMF α) (f : α → MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hf : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a) :
    ∑ a : α, (p a).toReal * Real.rpow (f a) (1 / (n : MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)) ≤
      Real.rpow (∑ a : α, (p a).toReal * f a) (1 / (n : MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
The uniform probability mass function is invariant under transport by an
equivalence.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem PMF.uniformOfFintype_map_equiv
    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    (e : α ≃ β) :
    (PMF.uniformOfFintype α).map e = PMF.uniformOfFintype β := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Marginalize a uniform PMF-weighted sum along the first coordinate of a
product equivalence.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem PMF.uniformOfFintype_sum_equiv_fst_smul {γ α β M : Type*}
    [Fintype γ] [Nonempty γ]
    [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [Finite β] [Nonempty β]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module MIPStarRE.LDT.Error M]
    (e : γ ≃ α × β) (f : α → M) :
    ∑ x : γ, (PMF.uniformOfFintype γ x).toReal • f (e x).1 =
      ∑ a : α, (PMF.uniformOfFintype α a).toReal • f a := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
For finite probability mass functions, total variation is the total positive
part of the signed weight difference `q - p`.

This is the finite PMF form of the elementary total-variation calculation used
in Proposition `prop:ld-dnoteq` of `references/ldt-paper/ld-pasting.tex`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem PMF.totalVariationDistance_eq_sum_max_sub {α : Type*}
    [Fintype α] (p q : PMF α) :
    totalVariationDistance p q =
      ∑ a : α, max 0 ((q a).toReal - (p a).toReal) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Total variation between the uniform probability mass function on a finite
ambient type and the uniform probability mass function on a nonempty finite
subset.

This is the PMF form of the uniform-versus-conditioned-uniform calculation in
Proposition `prop:ld-dnoteq` of `references/ldt-paper/ld-pasting.tex`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem PMF.totalVariationDistance_uniformOfFintype_uniformOfFinset_eq
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (s : Finset α) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    totalVariationDistance (PMF.uniformOfFintype α) (PMF.uniformOfFinset s hs) =
      1 - (s.card : MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / (Fintype.card α : MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Swap two nested finite expectations against uniform probability mass
functions.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem PMF.realWeightedSum_uniformOfFintype_comm {α β M : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module MIPStarRE.LDT.Error M]
    (f : α → β → M) :
    realWeightedSum (PMF.uniformOfFintype α)
        (fun a => realWeightedSum (PMF.uniformOfFintype β) (fun b => f a b)) =
      realWeightedSum (PMF.uniformOfFintype β)
        (fun b => realWeightedSum (PMF.uniformOfFintype α) (fun a => f a b)) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Reindex a polynomial-indexed sum by the value of the polynomial at a fixed point.

The low individual degree test frequently groups global polynomial answers by
the fiber of the evaluation map `h ↦ h u`.  This lemma records that finite
reindexing in the notation used throughout the LDT formalization.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.polynomial_sum_fiberwise
    (params : Parameters)
    [FieldModel params.q]
    (u : Point params)
    {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β]
    (f : Polynomial params → β) :
    (∑ h : Polynomial params, f h) =
      ∑ a : Fq params,
        ∑ h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun h : Polynomial params => h u = a), f h := by sorry

    M.outcome a ≤ 1 := by sorry

nodes.docstring: Projective submeasurement outcomes are Hermitian (PSD from idempotence).
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjSubMeas.outcome_hermitian {α : Type*} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : ProjSubMeas α ι) (a : α) :
    (P.outcome a)ᴴ = P.outcome a := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Postprocessing after transporting outcomes along an equivalence agrees with
postprocessing the original submeasurement after precomposing the readout map
with the same equivalence.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.SubMeas.postprocess_transport {α β γ : Type*} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (e : α ≃ β) (A : SubMeas α ι) (f : β → γ) :
    postprocess (transport e A) f = postprocess A (fun a => f (e a)) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Naturality of postprocessing with respect to transport along equivalences on
both the source and target outcome alphabets.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.SubMeas.postprocess_transport_equiv {α β γ δ : Type*} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [Fintype δ]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (eα : α ≃ β) (eγ : γ ≃ δ) (A : SubMeas α ι)
    (f : α → γ) (g : β → δ)
    (h : ∀ a, g (eα a) = eγ (f a)) :
    postprocess (transport eα A) g = transport eγ (postprocess A f) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Postprocessing is functorial: postprocessing by `f` and then by `g`
agrees with a single postprocessing by the composite `g ∘ f`.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.SubMeas.postprocess_comp {α β γ : Type*} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : SubMeas α ι) (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) :
    postprocess (postprocess A f) g = postprocess A (fun a => g (f a)) := by sorry

      trivialDistinguishedOutcome (e a₀) := by sorry

nodes.docstring: Postprocessed outcomes from the same ProjMeas commute.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas.postprocess_outcome_commute
    {α β γ : Type*} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : ProjMeas α ι) (f : α → β) (g : α → γ)
    (b : β) (c : γ) :
    (MIPStarRE.LDT.postprocess P.toSubMeas f).outcome b *
      (MIPStarRE.LDT.postprocess P.toSubMeas g).outcome c =
    (MIPStarRE.LDT.postprocess P.toSubMeas g).outcome c *
      (MIPStarRE.LDT.postprocess P.toSubMeas f).outcome b := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Expanding the left-tensor mass of a submeasurement on a bipartite state as
the sum of per-outcome left-tensor expectations.

This is a generic identity at the level of `ev ψ (leftTensor _)`: applying
`SubMeas.sum_eq_total`, pulling `leftTensor` through the finite sum via
`leftTensor_finset_sum`, and distributing `ev` through the sum via
`ev_finset_sum`. Using the definitional equalities
`subMeasMass ψ A.liftLeft = ev ψ A.liftLeft.total = ev ψ (leftTensor A.total)`,
this immediately yields the helper-stage opening
`subMeasMass ψ A.liftLeft = ∑ a, ev ψ (leftTensor (A.outcome a))` used in the
Section 9 / Section 12 calculations.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.ev_leftTensor_total_eq_sum_outcome {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ψ : QuantumState (ι × ι)) (A : SubMeas α ι) :
    ev ψ (leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) A.total) =
      ∑ a : α, ev ψ (leftTensor (ι₂ := ι) (A.outcome a)) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
Evaluation of a left-placed operator average is the average of the
left-placed evaluations.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.ev_leftTensor_averageOperatorOverDistribution {α : Type*}
    {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [DecidableEq ι₁] [Fintype ι₂] [DecidableEq ι₂]
    (ψ : QuantumState (ι₁ × ι₂)) (𝒟 : Distribution α)
    (A : α → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι₁) :
    ev ψ (leftTensor (ι₂ := ι₂) (averageOperatorOverDistribution 𝒟 A)) =
      avgOver 𝒟 (fun a => ev ψ (leftTensor (ι₂ := ι₂) (A a))) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
A real scalar on the right register factors out of a bipartite tensor product.

This restates `leftTensor_mul_rightTensor_smul_right` for the real scalar action
used by `averageOperatorOverDistribution`, coercing the real scalar to `ℂ` on
the tensor product.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.leftTensor_mul_rightTensor_real_smul_right
    {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [DecidableEq ι₁] [Fintype ι₂] [DecidableEq ι₂]
    (c : Error) (A : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι₁) (B : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι₂) :
    leftTensor (ι₂ := ι₂) A * rightTensor (ι₁ := ι₁) (c • B) =
      (c : ℂ) • (leftTensor (ι₂ := ι₂) A * rightTensor (ι₁ := ι₁) B) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
A filtered diagonal tensor sum of two submeasurements is a contraction.

The estimate uses only positivity and the submeasurement total bound on the
left factor, together with the pointwise `≤ 1` bound on the right factor.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.SubMeas.opTensor_sum_filter_le_one {α ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (S T : SubMeas α ι) (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter P, opTensor (S.outcome x) (T.outcome x) ≤
      (1 : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ι × ι)) := by sorry

nodes.docstring:
A single tensor summand with a sandwiched left register is nonnegative in
expectation.

The left register `Outer_o * Inner_i * Outer_o` is PSD by sandwich positivity,
and the right-register outcome is PSD, so their tensor product is PSD.
nodes.formal_statement:
theorem MIPStarRE.LDT.sandwichTensorSummand_nonneg
    {α β γ ιA ιB : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    (ψ : QuantumState (ιA × ιB))
    (Outer : SubMeas β ιA) (Inner : SubMeas α ιA) (Right : SubMeas γ ιB)
    (o : β) (i : α) (r : γ) :
    0 ≤ ev ψ
      (leftTensor (ι₂ := ιB)
          (Outer.outcome o * Inner.outcome i * Outer.outcome o) *
